title: Recordings: Marie Laveau for Joe Mares and other sessions
summary: After rejoining in 1953 she recorded Marie Laveau with Papa's band for Joe Mares and did other sessions; the big band made no records, only the eight-piece band earlier.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I see. When you rejoined the Celestan band, you were on the one record they made for Joe Merez's Southland, I know.
Oh, not when I first joined.
Weren't you? I mean after that. Quite some years after that. You know, the one that he has Marie Laveau and all of the…
Yes. And then I have been down there with Joe Merez on a lot of… with a lot of groups.
Other groups too. That's right. With Johnny St. Cyril, we have a lot of… Yes. Doc Suchon. And some of those groups.
I've been on quite a few sessions.
Maybe one of Jim Robinson or something. Yes, I know.
But we did make Marie Laveau with Papa's band for Joe Merez. Yes, I know. Golden Wedding, I think it's called.
Yes. With the big band, did they do any recording?

No, we didn't do any recording with the big band. We did the recording when we had the eight piece band. The eight piece band. And then in later years, after I rejoined Papa's house then, around 53, we made this record for Merez. But during the time that we had the 14 piece band, we didn't do any recording.
